caption: A weighted fishing line is cast far out over a lake from the bank, and the weight splashes into the water.

sa.check: A weighted fishing line is cast from a bank over a lake.
The line trails behind the weight.
The cast comes first and the splash follows.

pc.expect: The weight flies in an arc pulling the line behind it.
pc.fail: It flies flat; or stops in the air; or changes direction.

pc.expect: It falls after the peak into the water.
pc.fail: It rises; or hovers; or floats on top.

pc.expect: A splash and rings appear where it enters.
pc.fail: No splash; or the splash is elsewhere; or the splash comes before it lands.

pc.expect: The line is a limp thread trailing behind.
pc.fail: It is a rigid rod; or stretches; or leads the weight.

pc.expect: One weight and one line keep their number.
pc.fail: The weight duplicates; or vanishes; or the line splits.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The rod and the lake stay the same.
pc.fail: The rod changes; or the lake changes colour; or the bank rearranges.
